entries.en: mine; ore
gold mine (lit. "gold mountain")
copper mine (lit. "copper mountain")
entries.notes: M 栏音写溢出汉字范围（tăng cŏa 之后多出 gûn coān），疑为串行；mina general 的确义待考，暂依汉栏「铜山」定。

entries.zh: 官署职务；部属之职（原件汉栏作「滚地龙」，义不详）
entries.en: ministry office; administrative post (Chinese column 滚地龙, sense unclear)
entries.notes: 西语词头指官职，汉栏「滚地龙」与之无涉，M 栏又标 T99 污损，四栏不能互证，暂存疑。

entries.en: subordinate; underling
entries.notes: 词头 Ministrao~ 疑为 ministros 之异写，依汉栏「属下」定为部属。

entries.en: underlings; servants; retainers
bailiff; court runner; officer of justice
entries.notes: M 栏夹入西语 officio，音写零乱（eg: ia chít ia），据汉栏「役」与词头定为差役。

entries.en: head constable; chief of a squad of runners
entries.notes: 「牌头」为衙役班头之称，与词头 ministro de justicia 相合，惟属专门官称，从中等置信。

entries.zh: 察看；细看（原件注 certificándose，即看准、确认）
entries.en: to examine; to look carefully (glossed "certificándose", i.e. making certain)
entries.notes: M 栏 cîa cîa gî 与「省」常读不合，且夹有西语注，音义仅部分可解。

entries.en: to view; to look at
entries.notes: 「观」对 koan-khòaⁿ 明确，然 M 栏末尾 leng gîn 无着落，疑为串入下条音写。

entries.en: to look at; to regard
to see
to stare fixedly; to gaze intently (de hito en hito)
entries.notes: 音写 chăy / băy chây chây 与「睛」难对，末注 con dividido 语意不明，仅据西语成语定为凝视。

entries.en: to look toward; to await expectantly
to gaze toward; to look up in expectation
entries.notes: 词头「el g espera」之 g 当为 que 之缩写（el que espera），据此定「瞻望等待」。

entries.en: to peruse; to look through (a book)
to look at the light; to see by reflected light
entries.notes: M 栏混入西语 luz / alumbrar / reflejo 作注，音写 chiôgia 未详。

entries.zh: 相看；互相观看；观赏取乐
entries.en: to look at one another; to watch for amusement
entries.notes: 词头 recreándose（自娱）与「相」互看之义仅部分相合，从中等置信。

entries.en: to see; to catch sight of
entries.notes: 汉栏「省见」疑为「看见」之形近误录，M 栏 cûa qûy 即 khoàⁿ-kìⁿ（看见）。

entries.en: to look at; to observe
entries.notes: 汉栏「省」在此对应 khoàⁿ（看），即「观看」之义。

entries.en: to look over; to inspect goods (géneros)
entries.notes: 汉栏作「赌」而音 chiâu 不合，疑为「瞧」之误录；词头 generos Lad~ 之 Lad~ 未详，暂存疑。
